inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.empty: Nothing here. Folio puts signals from your strategy, price alerts and digests in this inbox.

matrix.title: Which items reach your phone
matrix.intro: Everything lands in the inbox. Tick where a push should go as well. Quiet hours and the daily cap apply to all but critical items.
matrix.saved: Routing saved; it applies to the next item.

test.title: Test a channel
test.intro: Sends a test push now with the saved address and token.
test.ok: Sent. Check your phone: it should show "Folio test".

macroSettings.help1: Macro series are economic numbers such as interest rates, inflation and the dollar rate, one value per day or month. They are not prices of things you own. They help you see what the economy is doing around your holdings.
macroSettings.help2: Folio fetches them every morning. You can chart one on a dashboard (add the Macro widget), and a strategy rule can watch one, for example 'alert me if the 10-year real yield rises above 2 %'. A rate decision in the news also links to the sleeves that watch the series it speaks to.
macroSettings.help3: To start: get a free key at fred.stlouisfed.org (My Account, API Keys), paste it under Settings, Providers, then press Fetch now. If you do not care about macro numbers you can ignore this tab; nothing else depends on it.
macroSettings.intro: Indicator series are fetched every morning and can be charted on a dashboard and watched by a strategy rule. FRED series need the free FRED key under Providers.

systemInfo.title: This installation
systemInfo.diagnosticsNote: Something not working? This file lists how Folio is set up, what failed lately and what the server logged. It holds no API keys, passwords, holdings or amounts, so it is safe to attach to a question.
systemInfo.noReport: No report from the worker yet. It reports every 15 seconds once it runs; if this stays, check that the worker container is up.
systemInfo.notSeen: Not heard from for {{time}}: the worker may have stopped.
systemInfo.differentBuilds: The web and worker containers run different builds. Update the stack again in Portainer with “Re-pull image” so both use the newest one.
